interface.evidence: Original interface specifies two 2-bit inputs and one-bit output.

semantics.behavior: Combinational z equals 1 exactly when A and B have the same binary value; otherwise 0.
semantics.cycles: No clock or latency: original asks for an equality circuit.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or specified initial output; z follows inputs combinationally.

numeric.input_domain: Each input is an unsigned 2-bit vector with binary values 0 through 3.
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic or width extension required.

verification.oracle: For each of the 16 binary input pairs, expected z is 1 only for the four diagonal pairs.
verification.sampling: Apply each pair and sample after 1 ns for combinational settling; no clock sampling is specified.
verification.failure: Use case inequality to detect wrong or unknown outputs, $fatal for mismatches and bounded timeout.
verification.coverage: All 16 input pairs, including both endpoints and every equal and unequal combination.

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for X or Z input bits is unspecified; use standard Verilog logical equality and verify the fully specified binary input domain.
